payload.body_you:
Close relationships stop getting credit for intention alone. Who follows through? Who waits until you are exhausted enough to drop the subject? Who keeps promising change while you keep compensating for the fact that it has not happened? Saturn moving through your 7th house puts the actual agreement under the relationship in plain view.

Say what you expect. Name who carries what, what support looks like, and which promises have been treated as understood without ever being discussed. Then watch the pattern over time. One good weekend does not repair months of avoidance. One difficult month does not erase years of reliability.
